paragraphs: Per the file, vote(X, S) - Votes is to be augmented with a "reference" (per the file) slot, X which is the (per the file) **latest** ancestor of this fork that this node voted on with a proof of switching. Per the file, as long as the node makes consecutive votes that (per the file) are all descended from (per the file) each other, the same X ought to be used for all those votes. Per the file, when the node makes a vote for (per the file) a slot s that (per the file) is not descended from the previous, X is to be set to the new slot s.

Per the file, all votes will then (per the file) be of the form (per the file) vote(X, S), where S (per the file) is the sorted list of (per the file) slots (s, s.lockout) being voted for. sections.heading: Definitions:
paragraphs: Per the file, optimistic Confirmation - A block (per the file) B is then said (per the file) to have achieved "optimistic (per the file) confirmation" if >2/3 of (per the file) stake have voted with votes (per the file) v where Range(v) for each (per the file) such v includes B.slot. Per the file, finalized - A block B (per the file) is said to be (per the file) finalized if at least one correct node has rooted B or (per the file) a descendant of B.

Per the file, reverted - A block B (per the file) is said to be (per the file) reverted if another block (per the file) B' that is not (per the file) a parent or descendant (per the file) of B was finalized.

sections.heading: Guarantees:
paragraphs: Per the file, a block B that (per the file) has reached optimistic confirmation (per the file) will not be reverted (per the file) unless at least one node is slashed.

sections.heading: Proof:
paragraphs: Per the file, assume for the sake (per the file) of contradiction, a block (per the file) B has achieved optimistic (per the file) confirmation at some slot (per the file) B + n for some (per the file) n, and: Another block (per the file) B' that is not (per the file) a parent or descendant (per the file) of B was finalized. Per the file, no nodes violated any slashing conditions. Per the file, by the definition of (per the file) optimistic confirmation, this means > 2/3 of nodes have each shown some vote (per the file) v of the form Vote(X, (per the file) S) where X <= B <= v.last.

Per the file, call this set of nodes the Optimistic Validators. Per the file, now given a node v in Optimistic Validators, (per the file) given two votes made (per the file) by v, Vote(X, S) (per the file) and Vote(X', S') where X (per the file) <= B <= S.last, and X' <= B <= S'.last, (per the file) (per the file) (per the file) (per the file) (per the file) (per the file) (per the file) (per the file) (per the file) (per the file) (per the file) (per the file) (per the file) (per the file) (per the file) (per the file) (per the file) (per the file) (per the file) (per the file) then X == X' otherwise an "Optimistic Slashing" condition is violated (the "ranges" of each vote would overlap at B).

Per the file, thus define the Optimistic (per the file) Votes to be the (per the file) set of votes made (per the file) by Optimistic Validators, where for each optimistic node v, the vote made (per the file) by v included in (per the file) the set is the (per the file) maximal vote Vote(X, S) (per the file) with the greatest S.last out (per the file) of any votes made by v (per the file) that satisfy X <= B <= S.last. sections.heading: Lemma 1:
paragraphs: Per the file, claim: Given a vote (per the file) Vote(X, S) made by a node V in the Optimistic Validators (per the file) set, and S contains a (per the file) vote for a slot s (per the file) for which: s + s.lockout > B, (per the file) s is not an ancestor or (per the file) descendant of B, then X > B. Per the file, proof: Assume for the (per the file) sake of contradiction a node V from the "Optimistic (per the file) Validators" set made such (per the file) a vote Vote(X, S) (per the file) where S contains a vote (per the file) for a slot s not (per the file) an ancestor or descendant of (per the file) B, where s + s.lockout > B, (per the file) but X <= B.

Per the file, let Vote(X', S') be (per the file) the vote in Optimistic Votes (per the file) set made by node V. Per the file, by definition of that (per the file) set (all votes optimistically (per the file) confirmed B), X' <= B (per the file) <= S'.last (see diagram above). Per the file, this implies that because (per the file) it's assumed above X (per the file) <= B, then X <= S'.last, so (per the file) by the slashing rules, either X (per the file) == X' or X < X' (otherwise would (per the file) overlap the range (X', S'.last)).

Per the file, case X == X': Consider s. Per the file, we know s != X (per the file) because it is assumed (per the file) s is not an (per the file) ancestor or descendant of (per the file) B, and X is (per the file) an ancestor of B. Per the file, because S'.last is a (per the file) descendant of B, this means (per the file) s is also not an (per the file) ancestor or descendant of S'.last. Per the file, then because S.last is (per the file) descended from s, then S'.last (per the file) cannot be an ancestor or descendant (per the file) of S.last either.

Per the file, this implies X != X' (per the file) by the "Optimistic Slashing" rules. Per the file, case X < X': Intuitively, (per the file) this implies that Vote(X, (per the file) S) was made "before" Vote(X', S'). Per the file, from the assumption above, (per the file) s + s.lockout > B > X'. Per the file, because s is not (per the file) an ancestor of X', (per the file) lockouts would have been violated when this node first attempted to submit (per the file) a switching vote to (per the file) X' with some vote (per the file) of the form Vote(X', S''). Per the file, since none of these (per the file) cases are valid, the (per the file) assumption must have been (per the file) invalid, and the claim is proven.
